1.web: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
1.asv: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

2.web: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
2.asv: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, The city of the great King.

3.web: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
3.asv: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.

4.web: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
4.asv: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.

5.web: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
5.asv: They saw it, then were they amazed; They were dismayed, they hasted away.

6.web: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
6.asv: Trembling took hold of them there, Pain, as of a woman in travail.

7.web: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
7.asv: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.

8.web: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
8.asv: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. [Selah

9.web: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the midst of your temple.
9.asv: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.

10.web: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
10.asv: As is thy name, O God, So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.

11.web: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of your judgments.
11.asv: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of thy judgments.

12.web: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
12.asv: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Number the towers thereof;

13.web: Mark well her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
13.asv: Mark ye well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces: That ye may tell it to the generation following.

14.web: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
14.asv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide even unto death.
